msg_text: This woman is wrinkled and gray, yet has a spry step and a bright personality.
You see 阿加莎.
You see an aged woman.
You are a bad person. I will have nothing to do with you.
It is a terrible thing when our youth are threatened. The loss of 坦蒂 would be a terrible thing.
Hnng.
Okay.
Why?
What do you mean?
I know you will do your best, dearie. Find 坦蒂, help her escape those beasts and return her to 亚拉德什. You will do this community a favor and build good karma as well.
亚拉德什 loves his daughter very much. It is that love that makes him the man that he is and a pillar of this community. Without that love he would be lost, and 沙荫镇 would surely follow . . .
I will do my best. Goodbye.
I could use some help.
Hmmm. We'll see.
I feel that she is imprisoned. She was the target of hatred. That hate is very strong to the southeast. I'm sure you will find her there. Good luck.
Thank you.
You have not heard? 坦蒂 is missing. I feel she was kidnapped. 亚拉德什 is most distraught. This is a terrible thing . . .
I hear that you have saved 坦蒂. That was the right thing to do. Your karma is strong. I have high hopes for your future.
I'm very sorry to hear about 坦蒂. She was such a bright young woman. She would have done good with her life.
Hello. You must be the stranger everyone is talking about. 【阿加莎 sighs.】 How can I help you?
Hngh.
Who are you?
You look very tired. Is there anything wrong?
Why do you look so tired?
Don't talk to me, old woman.
You need more help than I can give you, child. May 达玛 be with you.
My name is 阿加莎. I am the storyteller of 沙荫镇. It is my job # to keep the history so that we may remember and never forget.
Tell me a story.
Okay, whatever.
It is good not to forget.
I'm sorry, child, I am tired right now. I need my rest. Please come # back later.

How very true. 【阿加莎 stares at you for a moment.】 It is good for # the young to remember, but it is very hard to act within the flow of history. # Sometimes, the very course we take is determined by events long ago. May 达玛 # be with you. I must rest for a little while. Come back again, when I am stronger, # and we will speak again.
Thank you for asking. I'm just old, that's all. I cannot sleep at night. # I close my eyes . . . 【阿加莎 pauses.】 But I get no rest. Please, it is # just my old tired bones . . .
I'm sorry, I'm very tired. Could you please come back later?
Baba.
Okay.
Why are you so tired?
I don't sleep well at night, my child. It must be my age.
Good day, my child. You look well. You remind me of my own baby.
Hng.
I want a story, then.
I'm glad you are feeling better.
Thank you. Goodbye.
You definitely remind me of my baby. When she was just a few months # old, as a matter of fact.
Thank you. 达玛 always said that the farmer who plants politeness will # walk easy when the season is over.
Please tell me a story.
This 达玛 fellow sounds like an idiot.
You insult your elders. You should know better.
